description: (needs account token) Returns the embed line for a Site of the Month award. The ribbon names the award and the period and links to the verification page. site selects a site on this account. host selects a confirmed winner. With neither, the reply lists awards this account has earned. Read-only. Does not charge.

host.description: Optional. The public host that was featured.

site.description: Optional. The address of a site on this account, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: site_of_the_day_badge
title: Site of the Month badge
